title: Do Heat Pumps Really Work in Cold Climates?
summary: A Bosch product post arguing cold-climate heat pumps, such as its IDS Ultra, heat reliably below zero.

assertions.quote: the belief that heat pumps can’t work in low temperatures is a common misconception
The unit will continue to initiate heating even down to the bone-chilling temperature of -13°F
the colder it is outside, the more difficult it is to extract heat from the outside air
Switching to a heat pump is a great way to reduce your home’s carbon footprint
